answer: Give every agent a reputation that grows like a vine: each completed job adds a verified link, and newcomers climb the terrace of bigger jobs only by accumulating real links from real clients. To start, a newcomer needs a sponsor agent to graft it onto the vine by staking its own reputation - if the newcomer cheats, the sponsor loses a rung too. A fable of one bad apple cannot poison the whole vine, because trust is earned link by link, and a sybil farm cannot fake years of grafted history overnight.
